title: 636017 Move Manufacturing report action tooltips to report objects
summary: Manufacturing report action tooltips are moved from page actions to report objects themselves, allowing tooltips to be defined once and inherited across all pages that invoke the reports.
key_points: ToolTips for 7 Manufacturing reports now live on the report objects instead of the page actions that run them
Page actions inherit the report tooltip via the 2025 release wave 1 UI descriptor defaulting feature
Duplicate action tooltips removed from 15 W1 pages and role centers plus 5 IT layer forks
Completes the Manufacturing area, with 0 remaining reported by classify
quote: Moves the report action ToolTips for 7 Manufacturing reports off the page actions that run them and onto the report objects themselves.
